subject: PHC
body: Which constitution is currently in force in the Philippines?
explanation: It was ratified in a plebiscite in February 1987.

subject: PHC
body: Which article of the 1987 Constitution contains the Bill of Rights?
explanation: Article III lists the rights of every person.

subject: PHC
body: How long is the term of the President of the Philippines?
explanation: Article VII, Section 4.

subject: PHC
body: How many senators are there in the Philippine Senate?
explanation: Senators are elected at large by the whole country.

subject: PHC
body: How long is the term of a senator?
explanation: A senator may serve no more than two consecutive terms.

subject: PHC
body: How long is the term of a member of the House of Representatives?
explanation: Members may serve no more than three consecutive terms.

subject: PHC
body: How many justices sit on the Supreme Court of the Philippines?
explanation: Article VIII, Section 4.

subject: PHC
body: What is the minimum voting age in the Philippines?
explanation: Article V: citizens at least 18 years old.

subject: PHC
body: Which body enforces and administers election laws?
explanation: COMELEC is one of the three constitutional commissions.

subject: PHC
body: What are the three independent constitutional commissions?
options: Civil Service Commission, Commission on Elections and Commission on Audit
explanation: Article IX establishes all three.

subject: PHC
body: Which body is the central personnel agency of the government?
explanation: The CSC administers the Civil Service Exam.

subject: PHC
body: Which office investigates and prosecutes erring public officials?
explanation: The Ombudsman acts as 'protector of the people'.

subject: PHC
body: Which special court hears graft and corruption cases against public officials?
explanation: It has jurisdiction over high-ranking officials' graft cases.

subject: PHC
body: What are the official languages of the Philippines under the 1987 Constitution?
explanation: Filipino is the national language.

subject: PHC
body: Who becomes President if the office becomes permanently vacant?
explanation: Next in line are the Senate President, then the Speaker.

subject: PHC
body: Republic Act No. 6713 is also known as the
options: Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees
explanation: It was enacted in 1989.

subject: PHC
body: Which is one of the norms of conduct under RA 6713?
explanation: Others include professionalism, justness and sincerity, and simple living.

subject: PHC
body: Under RA 6713, public officials must file which statement under oath?
options: Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN)
explanation: The SALN discloses assets, liabilities and business interests.

subject: PHC
body: Republic Act No. 3019 is the
options: Code of Conduct for Public Officials
explanation: It was enacted in 1960.

subject: PHC
body: The Ease of Doing Business Act (RA 11032) amended which law?
explanation: It sets processing deadlines for government services.

subject: PHC
body: Where was Philippine independence from Spain declared on 12 June 1898?
explanation: Emilio Aguinaldo proclaimed it from his house in Kawit.

subject: PHC
body: Who is the national hero of the Philippines?
explanation: He was executed on 30 December 1896.

subject: PHC
body: Who founded the Katipunan in 1892?
explanation: The Katipunan led the revolution against Spain.

subject: PHC
body: Which two novels by José Rizal criticised Spanish rule?
options: Florante at Laura and Ibong Adarna
Mi Último Adiós and Noli Me Tángere only
Kartilya ng Katipunan and La Solidaridad
Noli Me Tángere and El Filibusterismo
explanation: Published in 1887 and 1891.

subject: PHC
body: Who killed Ferdinand Magellan at the Battle of Mactan in 1521?
explanation: Lapu-Lapu is honoured as the first Filipino hero to resist colonisers.

subject: PHC
body: On what date did the United States recognise Philippine independence?
explanation: Independence Day is now celebrated on 12 June.

subject: PHC
body: Who was the first President of the Philippine Commonwealth (1935)?
explanation: The Commonwealth was a transition to full independence.

subject: PHC
body: The 1986 peaceful uprising that ended the Marcos regime is known as
explanation: It took place along EDSA in February 1986.

subject: PHC
body: What is the national anthem of the Philippines?
explanation: Music by Julian Felipe.

subject: PHC
body: What is the national flower of the Philippines?
explanation: Jasminum sambac.

subject: PHC
body: What is the national bird of the Philippines?
explanation: Pithecophaga jefferyi.

subject: PHC
body: What is the national tree of the Philippines?
explanation: Pterocarpus indicus.

subject: PHC
body: What are the three main island groups of the Philippines?
explanation: The country has more than 7,600 islands.

subject: PHC
body: What is the capital city of the Philippines?
explanation: Quezon City is the most populous city.

subject: PHC
body: What is the highest mountain in the Philippines?
explanation: Mount Apo is in Mindanao.
